title: Full-stack product systems
summary: Built across NestJS APIs and Nuxt frontends with resource modules, sheet-style CRUD, auth, search, file uploads, DTO validation, and Mongo/Mongoose data models.

title: Enterprise UI workflows
summary: Shipped admin-facing screens for sheets, create/edit flows, autocomplete options, attachments, history/restore behavior, and data-heavy catalog management.

title: Backend architecture
summary: Designed reusable resource services, controllers, summarizers, searchers, transactional writes, version history, mail, generated files, image handling, and seed imitators.

title: Mobile and native-ready features
summary: Worked on a Nuxt/Ionic/Capacitor mobile app with camera, push notifications, haptics, QR scanning, persistent auth state, and native/browser behavior checks.

title: CI/CD and deployment
summary: Maintained Jenkins pipelines that build Docker images, inject production environment files through credentials, run containers, restart services, and prune build artifacts.
